title: mapget
description: Plugin that converts any image into map.
body:
# mapget

Simple plugin for Paper that converts images into maps.

## Quick Start Guide
1. Upload an image anywhere you want (for example: [catbox.moe](https://catbox.moe/))
2. Type in Minecraft `/map get <url>`
3. Get the map
4. Done!

Note: `/map help`

### Example:
`/map get https://files.catbox.moe/9cyuvs.jpg` will create this:

<details>
<summary>cool text for spoiler</summary>

![niko confirmed ✅](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ad8fbc2b3914fa355db7236174d812f90b78da4.png)

</details>
